job.title: Senior Architect / Associate – Super Prime Residential
job.description:
Senior Architect / Associate – Super Prime Residential

London | Permanent | Competitive Salary + Bonus + Excellent
Benefits

My client is a highly respected, design-led architectural practice specialising in exceptional high-end and super prime residential projects. They are looking to appoint a Senior Architect or Associate to play a key role in leading the delivery of bespoke luxury homes, working closely with discerning private clients and skilled consultant teams.

This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced architect with a passion for beautifully crafted residential architecture, who enjoys taking ownership of projects from concept through to completion.

The Role

You will lead the design and technical delivery of prestigious residential schemes, managing projects, clients and project teams while ensuring the highest standards of design and execution.

Projects include:

  • Super prime private residences
  • High-end refurbishments and retrofit projects
  • Grade II and Grade II* listed buildings
  • Luxury interior architecture and bespoke fit-outs

About You

  • The successful candidate will ideally have:
  • ARB registration and a recognised degree in Architecture (or equivalent).
  • Extensive experience delivering high-end or super prime residential projects in the UK.
  • Strong knowledge of refurbishment, retrofit and listed building projects.
  • Experience leading luxury interior architecture schemes.
  • Excellent AutoCAD skills.
  • The confidence to lead project teams and mentor junior staff.
  • Strong client-facing experience with the ability to build lasting relationships.
  • Experience liaising with contractors, consultants and wider design teams throughout all project stages.
  • Excellent technical detailing and project delivery skills.

What's on Offer

Alongside the opportunity to work on some of London's finest residential projects, my client offers an outstanding working environment and benefits package, including:

  • Quarterly bonus scheme
  • 28 days' annual leave plus Christmas office closure
  • Free lunches
  • Free coffee
  • Two work-from-home days per month
  • Work from abroad policy
  • Annual overseas team trip (including destinations such as Italy and France)
  • Monthly international team dinners
  • Cycle to Work scheme
  • Season ticket loan

If you're an accomplished Senior Architect or Associate looking to work on some of the UK's most prestigious residential projects within a collaborative and social studio, we'd love to hear from you.

job.title: Project Architect | Heritage, Residential & Adaptive Reuse
job.description:
Project Architect | Heritage, Residential & Adaptive Reuse

Location: Central London
Job Type: Full-time, Permanent
Salary: Competitive, dependent on experience

My client is an award-winning, design-led architecture and interiors practice seeking a talented ARB Registered Project Architect to join its collaborative London studio.
This is an exciting opportunity to take the lead on a diverse portfolio of beautifully crafted projects, ranging from multi-unit residential developments to the adaptive reuse and sensitive refurbishment of significant listed buildings. The practice works across architecture and interiors for both private and commercial clients, delivering high-quality design with a strong emphasis on craftsmanship, sustainability and contextual sensitivity.
Working closely with the Directors and wider team, you will have the opportunity to run projects through all RIBA stages, taking ownership of design, technical delivery and client relationships while contributing to the creative direction of the studio.

The Role
As a Project Architect, you will:

  • Lead projects across all RIBA work stages from concept through to completion.
  • Manage project programmes, consultants and client relationships.
  • Deliver high-quality design and technical packages.
  • Work on a varied portfolio including residential, hospitality, heritage, commercial and adaptive reuse projects.
  • Coordinate multidisciplinary teams to ensure projects are delivered on time and to the highest standard.
  • Contribute creatively within a highly collaborative and design-focused studio environment.

About You
ARB Registered Architect.

  • A minimum of three years' post-Part 3 experience within a UK architectural practice.
  • Proven project running and delivery experience across all RIBA stages.
  • Strong technical detailing and presentation skills.
  • Experience working on residential, heritage, refurbishment or adaptive reuse projects would be highly advantageous.
  • Excellent understanding of UK Building Regulations and construction processes.
  • Proficient in Vectorworks, SketchUp and Enscape, with a good working knowledge of Photoshop and other industry-standard software.
  • Highly organised with excellent communication and coordination skills.
  • A thoughtful designer with strong attention to detail and a collaborative approach.

What's on Offer
  • The opportunity to work on exceptional residential, heritage and adaptive reuse projects.
  • A supportive, collaborative and design-led studio culture.

  • Excellent opportunities for professional development and career progression.

job.description:
Senior Architect | Senior Architectural Technologist | Architectural Technologist

London | Hybrid/Flexible Working | Competitive Salary

My client is an award-winning AJ100 architectural and town planning practice looking to recruit for three separate positions within its growing London studio:

Senior Architect
Senior Architectural Technologist
Architectural Technologist

This is an excellent opportunity to join a collaborative, design-led practice working on a diverse portfolio of large-scale residential and mixed-use developments, alongside projects within the commercial, education, healthcare and hospitality sectors.

You'll play a key role in delivering technically complex projects from RIBA Stage 4 through to completion, producing high-quality technical information, coordinating consultants and contractors, and ensuring projects are delivered to the highest standards. Depending on your level, you'll also have the opportunity to lead project teams, mentor junior staff and build strong client relationships.

job.title: BIM Coordinator
job.description:
The BIM Coordinator plays a vital role in enhancing project delivery processes within my client’s architectural practice.

This position extends beyond model coordination, focusing on improving workflows, maintaining information consistency, and supporting teams in delivering high-quality, model-based outputs efficiently.

Working closely with project teams and senior leadership, the BIM Coordinator will help embed best practices across ArchiCAD-based workflows while contributing to the continued development of the practice’s digital strategy.

Key Competencies, Skills & Requirements

  • Degree or diploma in Architecture, Architectural Technology, or a related discipline (MA in Architecture or equivalent preferred).
  • Minimum of 2 years’ experience as a BIM Coordinator within the UK commercial sector, ideally gained within a medium to large architectural practice.
  • Strong understanding of current BIM workflows, processes, and industry requirements.
  • Proven experience using ArchiCAD within an architectural environment.
  • Sound knowledge of the UK BIM Framework, including ISO 19650 and associated standards.
  • Understanding of the Information Management Mandate and UK BIM Framework.
  • Experience with ArchiCAD is essential; familiarity with Solibri, Rhino, Grasshopper, and Revit interoperability is advantageous.
  • Strong practical experience in clash detection and issue management.
  • Knowledge of UK Building Regulations and project specification management is desirable.
  • Good understanding of file exchange procedures, uploads/downloads, and management within a Common Data Environment (CDE).
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines effectively.
  • Collaborative, approachable, and enthusiastic team player.
  • Passion for continuous learning and keeping up to date with BIM developments and emerging technologies.
  • Ability to understand and map design workflows across all RIBA stages.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with a focus on identifying root causes rather than symptoms.
  • Interest in automation and scripting tools such as Grasshopper and Python.

Key Responsibilities & Accountabilities

  • BIM Management & Support
  • Act as the primary point of contact for all ArchiCAD, CAD, and BIM-related queries within the practice.
  • Support project teams in developing and implementing modelling strategies aligned with project-specific BIM requirements.
  • Assist in managing and maintaining ArchiCAD software, templates, protocols, and libraries across the practice.
  • Help ensure project compliance with BIM standards, industry requirements, and collaborative workflows involving consultants, clients, and stakeholders.
  • Provide day-to-day troubleshooting and technical support for ArchiCAD-related issues.
  • Support the BIM Manager in maintaining practice-wide BIM manuals and project-specific BIM Execution Plans (BEPs).
  • Project Responsibilities
  • Identify workflow inefficiencies and propose practical improvements.
  • Support structured information management across all project stages.
  • Reduce duplication and rework through improved model and data coordination.
  • Assist Project Leads and Design Teams in establishing project goals, workflows, and BIM implementation strategies to meet contractual obligations.
  • Maintain project BIM documentation including BEPs, TIDPs, BRMs, and related records.
  • Implement digital standards consistently across assigned projects.
  • Liaise with client BIM advisors and external design team BIM Coordinators to manage coordinated BIM models and project documentation.
  • Perform quality assurance checks on BIM models.
  • Develop and maintain a consistent library of ArchiCAD objects and components.
  • Promote modelling best practices to support 3D, 4D, and 5D project delivery.
  • Deliver BIM-related training and technical support to project teams.
  • Training & Development
  • Conduct ArchiCAD inductions for new team members and support ongoing staff training initiatives.
  • Stay informed of BIM regulations, standards, and industry developments, sharing relevant updates with project teams.
  • Assist in preparing reports and documentation relating to BIM coordination, compliance, and project delivery requirements.
  • Collaboration & Coordination
  • Work closely with Job Runners and project teams to define BIM deliverables and improve interdisciplinary collaboration.
  • Assist with federated model coordination and clash detection using software such as Solibri.
  • Participate in BIM and CAD coordination meetings and contribute to the development of standardised workflows across the practice.
  • Liaise with the IT team regarding software updates, licensing, and server management associated with BIM processes.
  • Quality Assurance & Standards
  • Ensure ArchiCAD models are maintained in accordance with agreed modelling standards and quality procedures.
  • Assist in updating and refining ArchiCAD templates and libraries to improve workflow efficiency.
  • Support the BIM Manager in reviewing project workflows and identifying opportunities for continuous improvement.
  • Provide guidance on visual outputs and presentation standards, including model-based drawings and 3D visualisations.

Workflow & Process Improvement

  • Identify inefficiencies within project workflows and recommend effective improvements.
  • Support structured information flow throughout all RIBA stages.
  • Minimise duplication and rework through enhanced model and data management practices.
  • Contribute to the ongoing development of practice-wide digital standards, workflows, and BIM processes.

About My Client

My client is a highly respected architectural practice specialising in traditional and progressive classical architecture alongside contextual urbanism. Led by an experienced executive team and design directors with distinct design approaches, the practice delivers a diverse portfolio of work across the UK and internationally.

Projects include new-build town and country houses, renovations, extensions, heritage and listed buildings, as well as commercial, healthcare, office, residential, and large-scale masterplanning developments. The practice is recognised for combining traditional architectural principles with innovative and collaborative project delivery methods.

job.title: Intermediate Architect
job.description:
Our clients work spans residential, hospitality, commercial, cultural, and institutional projects, with strengths in adaptive reuse, new construction, planning, and interiors. They are passionate in their approach and believe great buildings come from dialogue, curiosity, and a balance of creativity and technical rigor.

Who You Are
You’re an architect who sees every project as a chance to shape meaningful places. Visionary yet precise, collaborative yet self-directed, you pair strong design instincts with technical depth. You take ownership, communicate clearly, and elevate work through leadership, mentorship, and thoughtful engagement with clients, consultants, and colleagues.

The Role
As an Architectural Designer II / Architect II, you’ll help drive design development, solve complex technical challenges, and contribute to projects from concept through construction. You’ll apply advanced architectural concepts, coordinate with multidisciplinary teams, and support the development of details, documents, and presentations with increasing independence. You may also guide junior staff.

What You’ll Do
Design & Planning
  • Contribute to design from early concept through detailed documentation
  • Create presentations, renderings, 3D views, and material selections
  • Translate leadership direction into clear design output
  • Understand scope, schedules, and deliverables

Project Coordination
  • Assist with meeting agendas, invites, and minutes
  • Work closely with consultants and manage BIM coordination
  • Support contractor communication, RFIs, and submittals
  • Provide mentorship to less experienced team members

Documentation
  • Produce DD and CD drawings, schedules, and specifications
  • Integrate design changes and coordinate consultant sets
  • Develop and refine project details
  • Organize correspondence and support client meeting prep

Quality & Technical Excellence
  • Follow studio standards and checklists
  • Apply working knowledge of codes and accessibility requirements
  • Maintain clean digital organization and self-check work

Construction Administration
  • Support site visits, shop-drawing review, RFIs, and punch lists
  • Attend progress meetings as directed
  • Help maintain CA logs and prepare record documents

Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s in Architecture or related field
  • 6+ years of professional experience with a strong portfolio
  • Proficiency in Revit, Rhino, AutoCAD, SketchUp, Adobe Suite, Enscape, Procore, Bluebeam, and MS Office
  • Strong design, communication, coordination, and organizational skills
  • Planning experience

Studio Culture & Benefits
Our client are a award winning practice in the heart of Manhattan. They are a collaborative, community-minded studio with an open, design-focused culture.

Expect weekly team lunches, design presentations, offsite explorations, and an active in-house arts program.

Benefits include competitive compensation, paid time off, health insurance, 401(k), professional development support, and assistance with licensure and certifications.

job.title: Project Architect
job.description:
This is an exciting opportunity to work on a mix of residential façade remedial projects, office retrofits, and large master-planning schemes, taking projects from concept design through to construction and completion.

About the Role
My client’s practice has been heavily involved in façade remedial projects, often initiated for fire safety compliance. These projects provide engaging technical challenges, offering the chance to develop deep expertise in façade design while working closely with full consultant and contractor teams. Alongside remedial work, there are opportunities to contribute to office retrofit and master-planning projects, some progressing through RIBA Stage 3 towards planning applications.

The role involves leadership in design and technical delivery, including acting as or supporting the Building Regulations Principal Designer, making it ideal for someone with prior experience and enthusiasm for this responsibility.

Key Responsibilities
  • Lead and contribute to the design and technical delivery of façade remedial projects, while supporting wider new build schemes.
  • Manage and coordinate detailed design and construction packages.
  • Organise, chair, and minute meetings and workshops.
  • Ensure compliance with UK Building Regulations throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Engage effectively with clients, contractors, and stakeholders.
  • Mentor junior staff and foster team collaboration and knowledge sharing.

Skills & Experience
  • ARB-registered Architect with 5–10 years post-Part 2 experience (ideally 5 post-Part 3).
  • Proven experience in the technical design and delivery of UK construction projects, particularly façade remediation.
  • Strong knowledge of UK Building Regulations and CDM duties.
  • Experience acting as or supporting a Principal Designer is highly desirable.
  • Excellent technical detailing ability, especially in retrofit and remedial works.
  • Proficient in CAD, ideally with BIM/Revit experience.
  • Confident communicator, capable of liaising with clients, consultants, and contractors.
  • Highly organised, self-motivated, and able to manage multiple projects and teams.

Why Join My Client?
  • Work on meaningful, safety-critical projects that improve building performance.
  • Join a friendly, collaborative, and supportive studio culture.
  • Benefit from ongoing CPD and professional development opportunities.
  • Flexible hours and remote working options.
  • Grow with a practice that values design quality, technical excellence, and social responsibility.

job.description:

This role is a fantastic opportunity for a BIM expert to support architectural project teams in utilizing BIM tools and workflows, particularly Autodesk Revit.

Job Summary:
The BIM Coordinator will provide technical support directly to project team members, liaise with the Senior BIM Coordinator, and ultimately report to the Technical Director (BIM). The successful candidate will be responsible for understanding the team's needs for training, workflows, or content and will come from an architectural background with strong communication skills and competencies in the following areas:

Key Responsibilities:
Management:
  • Possess a working knowledge of ISO 19650 standards.
  • Understand and address the information needs of clients.
  • Assist in the creation and management of a BIM Execution Plan (BEP).
  • Help establish the project team's Responsibility Matrix (MPDT).
  • Support the population of a Task Information Delivery Plan (TIDP).
  • Develop and enforce a BIM modeling standard.
  • Administer and manage a Common Data Environment (CDE).
  • Ensure compliance with project standards and protocols.
  • Chair BIM project and team meetings, providing support and training to in-house project teams.
  • Maintain and deliver project BIM models, ensuring adherence to BIM standards, validation, and quality assurance processes.
  • Experience with medium to large-scale complex projects within an architectural office is essential.
  • Advanced understanding of volume strategies, clash avoidance strategies, issue management, and MEP & Structural coordination management is highly beneficial.

Production:
  • Setup and manage in-house project models and models for the supply chain.
  • Produce 3D model elements and manage model outputs.
  • Assist in the preparation and management of COBie information and deliverables.

Software Expertise:
  • Advanced knowledge and experience with Revit and related plugins are essential.

  • Experience with point cloud software such as ReCap Pro is beneficial.

  • Experience with issue-tracking software such as Revizto, BIMCollab, and/or BIM Track is beneficial.
  • Knowledge of other software such as Rhino, Enscape, and NBS Chorus is beneficial.

If you’re looking for a role where your voice matters, your expertise is valued, and your projects inspire – this could be the move for you.

Please submit your CV and portfolio, highlighting your technical and conservation expertise, along with your availability and Right to Work in the UK.

job.title: BIM Manager
job.description:
The ideal candidate will have a minimum of 10 years of relevant experience in the field of architecture with a strong proficiency in Revit software.

This position is a mix of a BIM Manager and a hands on design involved Architect so its essential you have this experience.
Responsibilities:

  • Oversee and manage the implementation of BIM processes and standards throughout the organization.
  • The BIM Manager will support the design and delivery of project specific BIM plans during the life cycle of each project.
  • Collaborate with project teams to develop BIM Execution Plans (BEP) and ensure compliance with project requirements.
  • Provide training and support to team members on BIM software tools, including Revit, and promote best practices for model development and management.
  • Lead the creation and maintenance of BIM libraries, templates, and families to streamline project workflows and improve efficiency.
  • Manage clash detection and coordination processes to identify and resolve conflicts in the BIM models.
  • Ensure the accuracy and completeness of BIM models and data throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Coordinate with external consultants, contractors, and clients to exchange BIM data and facilitate interdisciplinary collaboration.
  • Stay updated on industry trends, software updates, and emerging technologies related to BIM and provide recommendations for process improvements.
  • Serve as a subject matter expert on BIM-related topics, providing guidance and support to project teams as needed.
  • Participate in BIM-related meetings, workshops, and conferences to share knowledge and best practices with colleagues.

Requirements:
  • Bachelor's degree in Architecture, Engineering, or related field.
  • Minimum of 10 years of experience in BIM implementation and management, in the architecture industry including design experience.
  • Proficiency in BIM software tools, particularly Autodesk Revit, with advanced knowledge of modeling, coordination, and documentation.
  • Strong understanding of BIM standards and protocols, such as COBie, IFC, and LOD requirements.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively collaborate with multidisciplinary teams.
  • Proven leadership abilities, with experience managing BIM projects and mentoring junior staff.
  • Familiarity with relevant codes, regulations, and industry standards in the UAE.
  • Certification in BIM-related software and methodologies is a plus.

If you meet the above requirements and are passionate about driving innovation and excellence in BIM, we encourage you to apply for this exciting opportunity by clicking the Apply button to be considered.

job.title: Rail Architect
job.description:
Job Title: Rail Architect (Revit Proficient)

Company Description: A prestigious AJ100 architectural practice, renowned for its excellence in design and innovation, is currently seeking a skilled Rail Architect to join our dynamic team. This practice has a rich history of delivering high-quality architectural solutions across various sectors, with a particular emphasis on rail projects. They are looking for a talented individual who can contribute to their continued success in this field.

Roles & Responsibilities:
  • Project Involvement: Participate in rail architecture projects, primarily focusing on stages 3-5 (developed design to technical design).
  • Revit Proficiency: Utilise Revit software to create detailed designs, ensuring accuracy and compliance with project requirements.
  • Detail Design Focus: Emphasize detail design and site stages, developing comprehensive and practical architectural solutions.
  • Collaboration and Coordination: Work closely with multidisciplinary teams, coordinating with engineers, designers, and clients to achieve optimal design outcomes.
  • Technical Documentation: Prepare technical documentation, ensuring clarity, precision, and adherence to relevant standards and regulations.
  • Quality Assurance: Uphold the high standards of design and documentation expected in a renowned AJ100 practice.
  • Client Liaison: Engage with clients to understand their needs, presenting designs and providing updates throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Site Visits: Conduct site visits to monitor construction progress, ensuring design intent is maintained and addressing any onsite challenges.
  • Project Management: Manage aspects of the architectural process, from conceptualization to completion, ensuring projects are delivered on time and within budget.
  • Continuous Learning: Stay updated with the latest industry trends, technologies, and best practices in rail architecture.

Skills & Experience:
  • Educational Requirement: Professional degree in Architecture.
  • Professional Experience: Proven experience in an architectural practice, with exposure to rail projects being advantageous.
  • Revit Expertise: Advanced proficiency in Revit is essential.
  • Design and Technical Skills: Strong capabilities in both design and technical aspects of architecture, particularly in detail design and site stages.
  • Rail Experience: While some prior experience in rail projects is preferred, a more significant emphasis is placed on overall architectural experience and skill set.
  • Communication and Interpersonal Skills: Excellent communication abilities, with a talent for working collaboratively in a team environment.
  • Problem-Solving Aptitude: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a detail-oriented approach.
  • Project Management Ability: Competency in managing project timelines, resources, and budgets.
  • Adaptability: Flexibility to adapt to various project demands and changing priorities.
  • Passion for Architecture: A genuine passion for architectural excellence and a commitment to continuous professional development.

Application Process: We invite interested candidates with a passion for architecture and a commitment to excellence to apply. Please include a portfolio showcasing relevant work, particularly any projects involving rail architecture or similar complexities.

Join their team and contribute to shaping the future of rail architecture with innovative designs and exceptional architectural solutions!

job.title: Intermediate Architect
job.description:
Our clients are passionate in their approach and believe great buildings come from dialogue, curiosity, and a balance of creativity and technical rigor.

Who You Are
You’re an architect who sees every project as a chance to shape meaningful places. With 5+ years of Architecture and Planning experience. Visionary yet precise, collaborative yet self-directed, you pair strong design instincts with technical depth. You take ownership, communicate clearly, and elevate work through leadership, mentorship, and thoughtful engagement with clients, consultants, and colleagues.

The Role
As an Architectural Designer II / Architect II, you’ll help drive design development, solve complex technical challenges, and contribute to projects from concept through construction. You’ll apply advanced architectural concepts, coordinate with multidisciplinary teams, and support the development of details, documents, and presentations with increasing independence. You may also guide junior staff.

What You’ll Do
Design & Planning
  • Contribute to design from early concept through detailed documentation
  • Create presentations, renderings, 3D views, and material selections
  • Translate leadership direction into clear design output
  • Understand scope, schedules, and deliverables

Project Coordination
  • Assist with meeting agendas, invites, and minutes
  • Work closely with consultants and manage BIM coordination
  • Support contractor communication, RFIs, and submittals
  • Provide mentorship to less experienced team members

Documentation
  • Produce DD and CD drawings, schedules, and specifications
  • Integrate design changes and coordinate consultant sets
  • Develop and refine project details
  • Organize correspondence and support client meeting prep

Quality & Technical Excellence
  • Follow studio standards and checklists
  • Apply working knowledge of codes and accessibility requirements
  • Maintain clean digital organization and self-check work

Construction Administration
  • Support site visits, shop-drawing review, RFIs, and punch lists
  • Attend progress meetings as directed
  • Help maintain CA logs and prepare record documents

Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s in Architecture or related field
  • 6+ years of professional experience with a strong portfolio
  • Proficiency in Revit, Rhino, AutoCAD, SketchUp, Adobe Suite, Enscape, Procore, Bluebeam, and MS Office
  • Strong design, communication, coordination, and organizational skills

Studio Culture & Benefits
Our client are a award winning practice in the heart of Manhattan. They are a collaborative, community-minded studio with an open, design-focused culture.

Expect weekly team lunches, design presentations, offsite explorations, and an active in-house arts program. Benefits include competitive compensation, paid time off, health insurance, 401(k), professional development support, and assistance with licensure and certifications.
